subject: Intermittent fasting: metabolic switch to longevity
script: From Agewell Brief: Intermittent fasting: metabolic switch to longevity. A new review confirms that time-restricted eating triggers conserved survival pathways, extending lifespan and improving health across species. Fasting activates AMPK and sirtuins, boosting autophagy and mitochondrial health. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
